# Repository maintenance

Repository: `GoGoKo699/Upstream-Electron-Preparation`.

Follow [AGENTS](../AGENTS.md), resolve the live main revision and read the
[model and claims](../research/MODEL_AND_CLAIMS.md) before making changes.
The owner has authorized changes and merge through a reviewed pull request.

## Documentation

The reader route presents the question, results, assumptions, derivations,
literature and reproduction. Keep work orders, dated progress, development
narrative and internal decisions in PR handoffs or the archive. State model
assumptions where they define a result; avoid inventories of unrelated work.
Keep the purpose-and-contact notice in README.md and llms.txt consistent.

## Verification and handoff

Preserve the scientific source and reference bytes identified by the
[manifest](../provenance/IMPORT_MANIFEST.json), including warning-bearing history.
Review the diff and run the three verification commands in AGENTS.md. The
[verification policy](../VERIFICATION.md) fixes the comparisons and tolerances.
Inspect the actual PR and merged-main artifacts against their source revisions.
Record revision identifiers, outcomes and numerical differences in the PR handoff.

The earlier workspace and work order are retained under
[development records](../archive/development/README.md).
